programs.title: McLintock!
programs.desc: Wealthy rancher G. W. McLintock uses his power and influence in the territory to keep the peace between farmers, ranchers, land-grabbers, Indians and corrupt government officials.

programs.title: Bad Man's River
programs.desc: Robber Roy King loses his wife, Alicia, to revolutionary Montero. Despite their rivalry they collaborate in an attempt to rob the Mexican government of one million dollars.

programs.title: Age of Dragons
programs.desc: In a tale inspired by Herman Melville's Moby Dick, picture a medieval world where Captain Ahab and his crew are on a mission to hunt down the mighty Great White Dragon. Ishmael, the charming harpooner, teams up with his buddy Queequeg to join this daring adventure. The heart of the story is Ahab's burning desire for revenge against the deadly "White Dragon" that wiped out his family in his youth, leaving him with lasting scars. This obsession pushes the crew further into a dark and dangerous journey.

programs.title: Father's Little Dividend
programs.desc: Shortly after coming to terms with his daughter's marriage, a father faces the prospect of becoming a grandfather.

programs.title: Down With Love
programs.desc: In 1962 New York City, love blossoms between a playboy journalist and a feminist advice author.

programs.title: Love & Other Drugs
programs.desc: In 1990s Pittsburgh, a medicine peddler starts a relationship with a young woman suffering from Parkinson's disease.
